purpose: Fictional pending requests that a traveller's request joins in the 3H demonstration mode (plan 3H/P5, ID-1). Economically identical to the pinned catalogue v1 lot of tests/test_coalition_formation.py, so the pool is anchored to an existing regression result.
limitations: Requests are fictional; they describe no real traveller.
Fixed before its first planning run (I1) and never tuned afterwards; any edit requires updating pool_sha256 here, and the loader refuses a mismatch.
At most 13 requests per route, and capacity margins chosen so that H2 holds with the largest admitted traveller request (20 seats) on every offer of catalog-v1.
